chef-verdana-health-design-system.DESIGN.name: Verdana Health Design System
chef-verdana-health-design-system.DESIGN.description: Verdana Health is a calm, trustworthy design system built for digital health platforms, telehealth dashboards, and patient-facing wellness applications. Its foundation of deep navy and soft sage greens evokes clinical precision tempered by warmth. The system prioritizes readability, accessibility, and a sense of reassurance across every touchpoint.
